sn35.16:1.3: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of the gratification of sights.
sn35.16:1.4: Mendicants, I went in search of the drawback of sights,
sn35.16:1.6: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of the drawback of sights.
sn35.16:1.7: Mendicants, I went in search of escape from sights,
sn35.16:1.9: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of escape from sights.
sn35.16:1.14: Mendicants, I went in search of the gratification of ideas,
sn35.16:1.16: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of the gratification of ideas.
sn35.16:1.17: Mendicants, I went in search of the drawback of ideas,
sn35.16:1.19: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of the drawback of ideas.
sn35.16:1.20: Mendicants, I went in search of escape from ideas,
sn35.16:1.22: I’ve seen clearly with wisdom the full extent of escape from ideas.
sn35.16:2.1: As long as I didn’t truly understand, mendicants, these six exterior sense fields’ gratification, drawback, and escape for what they are, I didn’t announce my supreme perfect awakening … I announced it.
sn35.16:2.2: Knowledge and vision arose in me:
sn35.16:2.3: ‘My freedom is unshakable; this is my last rebirth; now there’ll be no more future lives.’”
